card.name: Inside drug names, early syllables
card.fires_on: Short syllables partway through drug names, mostly cephalosporin-type names like ceftriaxone, ceftazidime and mefloquine, where more letters follow. It also fires on a few odd names and code terms in web text.

modes.label: Drug name syllables
modes.description: The early syllable of a longer drug name, such as ef or ft in cef- names.

modes.label: Odd web-text terms
modes.description: Isolated names or code words in general web text, such as file names and iterator functions.
